title: Tanker Crashes Into Cruise Ship in New Orleans 😱 #shorts
desc:
On Nov 13, 2026, the tanker Atlantic Asphalt struck the docked American Heritage riverboat on the Mississippi River in New Orleans. Nearly 200 people were aboard; the boat sank and rolled onto its side. Officials say 32 people were hurt, none critically, and no one died. Officials say the tanker lost control; the cause is under investigation.

Sources: Port of New Orleans, CBS News, ABC News, CNN, AP.
